candidates.source_name: Magyar Közlöny (Hungarian Official Gazette) – online edition
candidates.why_relevant: Primary legal publication venue for government decrees, ministerial decisions and the establishment/restructuring of state-controlled financial bodies (MFB, Eximbank/MEHIB, MÁK, Diákhitel). Appointments and organisational mandates of state entities are legally anchored here.
candidates.access_status: open, free PDF/issue downloads; no obvious API
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily issue-index crawl; download issue PDFs and text-extract; keyword filter on entity names (MFB, Eximbank, MEHIB, Magyar Államkincstár, Diákhitel Központ) plus 'kinevez', 'vezérigazgató', 'elnök', 'felmentés'.
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny vezérigazgató kinevezés MFB Eximbank

candidates.source_name: Hivatalos Értesítő (annex to Magyar Közlöny) – ministerial instructions / SZMSZ
candidates.why_relevant: Where ministerial 'utasítás' documents publish the Organisational and Operational Rules (SZMSZ) of state bodies such as Magyar Államkincstár — these literally define org structure, number of deputy presidents, and named leadership posts. The single best structural-change source for state financial bodies.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Issue-list crawl + PDF text extraction; regex on 'Szervezeti és Működési Szabályzat', 'NGM utasítás', 'Kincstár', 'elnökhelyettes'.
queries_used: MÁK Magyar Államkincstár szervezeti változás vezetői kinevezés allamkincstar.gov.hu közlemény

candidates.source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (NJT) – ministerial instructions database
candidates.why_relevant: Consolidated, searchable text of NGM/PM ministerial instructions establishing SZMSZ of MÁK and other state financial bodies (e.g. 3/2025. (I. 30.) NGM utasítás). Easier to diff over time than gazette PDFs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled fetch of instruction documents by identifier; store versions and diff org-structure sections.
queries_used: MÁK Magyar Államkincstár szervezeti változás vezetői kinevezés

candidates.source_name: Cégközlöny Online (Company Gazette, Ministry of Justice)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication of company-register changes — appointments and terminations of 'vezető tisztségviselő' (executive officers), supervisory board members, and registered-seat/structure changes for every Zrt., including MFB Zrt., Eximbank Zrt., MEHIB Zrt., Magyar Posta Zrt., Diákhitel Központ Zrt. and their subsidiaries. Legally authoritative and earlier than press coverage in many cases.
candidates.access_status: free public search interface; session/form-driven, likely no API
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watchlist of target company registration numbers (cégjegyzékszám); scripted form-post search of daily issues; parse section numbers 13 (vezető tisztségviselők) and 14 (felügyelőbizottság).
queries_used: Cégközlöny online cégközzététel vezető tisztségviselő változás keresés

candidates.source_name: Céginformációs portál (Igazságügyi Minisztérium) – company search
candidates.why_relevant: Official entry point to company data for state-owned financial entities; resolves exact legal names, registration numbers and current officers — the key that makes Cégközlöny monitoring precise, and reveals subsidiary/holding structure changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off actor-map build, then periodic re-check of the watchlist entities.
queries_used: Cégközlöny online cégközzététel vezető tisztségviselő változás keresés

candidates.source_name: Közbeszerzési Értesítő (Public Procurement Bulletin, KÖZBESZERZÉSI HATÓSÁG)
candidates.why_relevant: All national-threshold tenders by state-controlled financial bodies are published here — consultancy, HR/staffing, recruitment, IT development and outsourcing notices reveal org-change programmes, headcount plans and the winning suppliers. Also a pointer into supplier names.
candidates.access_status: open; notices served as PDF/HTML under /media/hirdetmeny/
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily bulletin index crawl; filter by contracting authority (MFB, Eximbank, MÁK, Magyar Posta, Diákhitel, MNB, MNV) and CPV codes 72xxxxxx (IT), 79xxxxxx (business/HR services); extract PDF text.
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Értesítő EKR banki informatikai szolgáltatás közbeszerzés

candidates.source_name: Közbeszerzési Hatóság – Adatbázisok / open data
candidates.why_relevant: Structured databases and downloadable datasets over procurement notices and contracts — the machine-readable route into the same corpus as the Értesítő, plus contract-award data that names suppliers of HR/IT services to state financial bodies.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inventory available datasets once; then scheduled bulk download/refresh where files are offered.
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Értesítő EKR banki informatikai szolgáltatás közbeszerzés

candidates.source_name: EKR – Elektronikus Közbeszerzési Rendszer
candidates.why_relevant: The operational e-procurement platform where procedures actually run; since mid-2024 it offers structured search by CPV code, subject and place of performance. Procedure documents (technical specs, scope of work) are far richer than the gazette notice and often describe target operating models and staffing.
candidates.access_status: public search of procedures; full documentation typically requires registration/login
candidates.legal_status: public portal with registration gate for some content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Public-facing procedure search scrape by CPV + contracting authority; escalate to registered access only if legally cleared. Respect robots/ToS.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + regulatory reasoning (424/2017 Korm. rendelet)
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Értesítő EKR banki informatikai szolgáltatás közbeszerzés
candidates.observed_blocker: Public search exists, but procedure documentation is generally behind EKR registration (economic-operator account).

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU procurement)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-threshold tenders from Hungarian state financial bodies appear here in structured, multilingual form. Contract notices and award notices for banking IT, core-system, consultancy and HR/staffing services expose transformation programmes and their suppliers.
candidates.access_status: open; official APIs and XML bulk downloads documented
candidates.legal_status: public EU official publication, reuse encouraged
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the official TED API / bulk XML packages filtered on country=HU, CPV 72/79 families, and buyer names; daily incremental pull.
queries_used: TED Tenders Electronic Daily Hungary banking IT services contract notice search API

candidates.source_name: MFB – Magyar Fejlesztési Bank Zrt. corporate site (sajtószoba / közérdekű adatok)
candidates.why_relevant: State development bank; publishes its own leadership appointments, board composition and mandatory 'közérdekű adatok' (organisational and personnel data). Directly on-topic for leadership moves and org changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl press/news section and the közérdekű adatok pages; snapshot the management page and diff for personnel changes; also check any career/karrier page for hiring signals.
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny vezérigazgató kinevezés MFB Eximbank

candidates.source_name: EXIM (Eximbank Zrt. / MEHIB Zrt.) corporate site
candidates.why_relevant: State export credit bank and export credit insurer under ministerial ownership control; CEO appointments are made by the minister and announced here and in the gazette (e.g. the July 2026 CEO change). Also a hiring source via its career page.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: News/press RSS or HTML crawl; management-page snapshot-and-diff; career page monitoring.
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny vezérigazgató kinevezés MFB Eximbank

candidates.source_name: Magyar Államkincstár (Hungarian State Treasury) – Vezetőség / szervezet pages
candidates.why_relevant: MÁK is a major retail government-securities distributor and payments/accounting infrastructure operator. Its published leadership list (president, elnökhelyettesek) and organisational chart change with each SZMSZ revision — a clean, diffable signal of org change and leadership moves.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly snapshot-and-diff of the leadership/organisation pages plus the közérdekű adatok section; correlate with NGM utasítás in NJT.
queries_used: MÁK Magyar Államkincstár szervezeti változás vezetői kinevezés allamkincstar.gov.hu közlemény

candidates.source_name: Magyar Posta Zrt. – Menedzsment / Szervezeti-személyzeti adatok
candidates.why_relevant: Magyar Posta operates a large financial-services arm (postal payments, agency banking, Posta Biztosító). It publishes a dated PDF of the company's leaders and a statutory szervezeti/személyzeti adatok page — an unusually explicit, versioned record of executive changes.
candidates.access_status: open; dated PDF of company leaders published
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the leaders PDF URL pattern (MP_A_Tarsasag_vezetoi_YYYY.MM.DD.pdf) and the közérdekű adatok page; extract and diff names/roles.
queries_used: Magyar Posta pénzügyi szolgáltatások vezérigazgató-helyettes kinevezés Diákhitel Központ vezetőváltás

candidates.source_name: Diákhitel Központ Zrt. (student loan agency) – official site
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned lender; its CEO changes are announced publicly and are a recurring channel for senior banking-sector people moving between OTP/MKB/MFB and state institutions — good for building the executive-mobility graph.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl news/sajtószoba and közérdekű adatok pages; corroborate with Cégközlöny entries for the same entity.
queries_used: Magyar Posta pénzügyi szolgáltatások vezérigazgató-helyettes kinevezés Diákhitel Központ vezetőváltás

candidates.source_name: MNV Zrt. (Hungarian National Asset Management) – közérdekű adatok
candidates.why_relevant: The state's asset manager: its portfolio lists and board-nomination records identify which financial entities are state-controlled and who sits on their boards. A pointer that keeps the actor map for this cell current as ownership moves between MNV, ministries and holding vehicles.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of portfolio and personnel data pages; maintain the state-ownership actor map from it.
queries_used: közadatkereső közérdekű adatok kozadat.hu szervezeti személyzeti adatok állami tulajdonú társaság MNV Zrt

candidates.source_name: Közadatkereső / közadattár (unified public-interest data search, operated by NISZ)
candidates.why_relevant: Central index of statutory public-interest data publications by public-duty organisations. Its 'szervezeti és személyzeti adatok' category is exactly the org-chart and leadership disclosure required by law — one crawl point covering many state financial bodies at once.
candidates.access_status: open web search; coverage/freshness uneven per the ÁSZ analysis
candidates.legal_status: public, mandated by 2011. évi CXII. tv.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a discovery index to enumerate publishing entities and their data URLs, then crawl the entity pages directly (index freshness is unreliable).
queries_used: közadatkereső közérdekű adatok kozadat.hu szervezeti személyzeti adatok állami tulajdonú társaság MNV Zrt

candidates.source_name: KÖZIGÁLLÁS / Közszolgálati állásportál (public-service job portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication venue for vacancies at public-administration employers, including the State Treasury and other state financial bodies. Job titles and unit names in the ads are a direct read on hiring volume and on newly created organisational units. Note: legacy domain kozigallas.gov.hu appears to have been superseded.
candidates.access_status: open search; no known public API
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily scrape filtered by employer (Magyar Államkincstár, ministries) and by keyword (pénzügy, informatika, treasury); store ad text + posting date.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles (who must publish vacancies) + hu search
queries_used: KÖZIGÁLLÁS közszolgálati állásportál kozigallas.gov.hu Magyar Államkincstár álláshirdetés

candidates.source_name: Kormany.hu – government / ministry press releases (NGM, ministerial ownership decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: The minister exercising ownership rights (currently the economy/energy portfolio) announces CEO appointments at Eximbank, MEHIB, MFB and treasury leadership here, often before or alongside the gazette. Also announces institutional mergers and mandate transfers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl ministry news feeds; keyword filter on institution names + 'kinevezés', 'vezérigazgató', 'átalakítás', 'tulajdonosi joggyakorló'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles (who appoints) + snowball from appointment coverage
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny vezérigazgató kinevezés MFB Eximbank

candidates.source_name: Állami Számvevőszék (ÁSZ) – audit reports on state financial institutions
candidates.why_relevant: State audit reports on MFB, Eximbank, MÁK and postal financial services describe governance structures, staffing, IT outsourcing and organisational deficiencies in detail — slow-moving but exceptionally substantive context for org-change analysis.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (monthly) crawl of the reports index filtered on audited-entity names; PDF text extraction.
queries_used: közadatkereső közérdekű adatok kozadat.hu szervezeti személyzeti adatok

candidates.source_name: Portfolio.hu – bank section (state-institution leadership coverage)
candidates.why_relevant: Fastest reliable secondary reporting on Hungarian banking leadership changes, including state institutions (e.g. the Diákhitel Központ CEO change). Useful as an early trigger to then go find the authoritative gazette/Cégközlöny record.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; store links + short excerpts only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/section crawl; headline+lead capture only, link back to source; use as a trigger for authoritative lookup.
queries_used: Magyar Posta pénzügyi szolgáltatások vezérigazgató-helyettes kinevezés Diákhitel Központ vezetőváltás

candidates.source_name: Világgazdaság / VG.hu – state-institution appointments coverage
candidates.why_relevant: Business daily that reliably carries ministry-sourced appointment announcements for state banks (EXIM, MFB, Diákhitel) with the ministerial framing and mandate description, which the gazette entry itself omits.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/section crawl of gazdaság and közélet sections; entity keyword filter.
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny vezérigazgató kinevezés MFB Eximbank

candidates.source_name: 424/2017. (XII. 19.) Korm. rendelet on electronic public procurement (Jogtár)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines what must be published where in EKR and the Közbeszerzési Értesítő, and the exemptions. Reading it tells the collection design which state-entity contracts are guaranteed to be visible and which are legally allowed to stay dark — essential for interpreting silence.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to calibrate collection scope; re-check on amendment.
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Értesítő EKR banki informatikai szolgáltatás közbeszerzés

negative_findings.description: No official aggregated feed or register of appointments specific to state-owned financial institutions was found; appointments are scattered across Magyar Közlöny, Hivatalos Értesítő, Cégközlöny, ministry press releases and each entity's own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Hungarian for a consolidated 'állami vállalati vezetői kinevezések' register returned only media coverage and per-entity pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell cannot rely on one feed; it needs a multi-source join keyed on a maintained entity watchlist, with Cégközlöny as the legal backstop.

negative_findings.description: EKR full procedure documentation is behind economic-operator registration; only the public procedure search and the gazette notice are freely retrievable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public materials describe the 2024 search improvements (CPV, subject, place of performance) but full documentation access is via the registered EKR system.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest org-change evidence (scope of work, target operating model, headcount) may be unreachable without an account, so the Közbeszerzési Értesítő/TED notice text must carry most of the signal.

negative_findings.description: The public-service job portal appears to have moved from kozigallas.gov.hu to kozszolgallas.ksz.gov.hu; the legacy domain was referenced only via third-party pages in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search surfaced kozszolgallas.ksz.gov.hu as the live portal while third-party sites still cite kozigallas.gov.hu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at the legacy host would silently collect nothing; both hosts should be probed by the deterministic verification pass.

negative_findings.description: The közadatkereső central index is documented (including by an ÁSZ analysis) as having uneven completeness and freshness of the statutory publications it indexes.
negative_findings.result_summary: ÁSZ published a dedicated analysis of the közadatkereső system's role, implying known compliance gaps.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using kozadat.hu as a primary collection surface would under-report; it should be used as a discovery index only, with per-entity crawling for actual data.

negative_findings.description: No specific recent appointment for the Magyar Posta financial-services deputy CEO post was located in this pass, despite Hungarian-language querying.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results surfaced the Magyar Posta management page and PDF plus a CEO dismissal report, but not a financial-services-specific deputy CEO appointment.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Magyar Posta's financial arm is a material payments actor; the gap should be closed by diffing the dated 'A Társaság vezetői' PDF series rather than by press search.

coverage_gaps.description: State-influenced (rather than state-owned) financial actors — e.g. banks with state or state-linked shareholding, Gránit/MBH-type structures, KAVOSZ/Széchenyi Kártya programme operators, Posta Biztosító — were not systematically enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the ownership map from MNV Zrt. portfolio data and Corvinus/holding-vehicle disclosures, then extend the Cégközlöny watchlist to those entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Only TED has a confirmed documented API/bulk-download route. Magyar Közlöny, Hivatalos Értesítő, Cégközlöny, EKR and KÖZIGÁLLÁS have no API confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical probe for RSS feeds, sitemap.xml, and stable URL patterns on each Hungarian portal; where absent, budget for HTML/PDF scraping with change-detection.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's pointer role — mining procurement awards for supplier names serving state financial bodies — was identified but not exercised; no award-notice supplier extraction was performed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a TED + Közbeszerzési Értesítő award-notice sweep for HU state financial buyers over the last 24 months, CPV 72/79, and emit the supplier list as new actor candidates for other cells.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature: only TED and entity English pages publish in English; gazette and company-register material is Hungarian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept Hungarian as the working language for this cell and budget for hu-language NER/normalisation of person and unit names rather than relying on English mirrors.

coverage_gaps.description: No assessment was made of how far back each portal's archive reaches (gazette archives, Cégközlöny back-issues, TED pre-2011 bulk).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe archive depth per source before backfill planning; TED bulk monthly collections are documented from January 2011.

brief: For Hungary's public-sector and state-controlled financial route, the authoritative layer is a small set of statutory publication venues — Magyar Közlöny and its Hivatalos Értesítő annex (ministerial SZMSZ instructions, mirrored in NJT), Cégközlöny Online for legally registered executive-officer changes at MFB, Eximbank/MEHIB, Magyar Posta, Diákhitel Központ, and the Közbeszerzési Értesítő plus EKR and TED for procurement. Cégközlöny and the Hivatalos Értesítő are the highest-value, least-exploited sources: they carry appointments and org-structure changes as legal fact rather than as press narrative. Hiring signal comes from KÖZIGÁLLÁS (note the apparent migration from kozigallas.gov.hu to kozszolgallas.ksz.gov.hu) and from HR/consultancy/IT tender notices, which double as a pointer into supplier names. The main constraint is machine access: only TED offers a documented API and bulk XML, EKR gates full documentation behind registration, and the Hungarian portals will require HTML/PDF scraping with snapshot-and-diff on entity leadership pages.
